parsedVerdict.reasoning: OrderController is an Express HTTP controller in the infrastructure layer. The one borderline item is listOrdersByStatus, which checks the status query parameter against a hardcoded list of OrderStatus values. This copies domain knowledge that should come from the domain OrderStatus definition. However, it only checks request input at the boundary before calling the use case. It does not enforce order state transitions or other business rules, so it does not count as a misplaced business rule. The file contains no persistence, no domain invariants and no use-case orchestration.
